_comment: Single source of truth for the FACTS scripts/bootstrap.sh, scripts/bootstrap.ps1, and tan (Rust, cross-platform) all need to assemble a Zephyr workspace (issue #917). Facts only -- control flow (ZEPHYR_BASE reuse/rejection, venv idempotency, .west branching) stays as CODE in each executor; do not grow this file into a step-execution DSL. Checkout/workspace-anchored paths use the ${SDK_ROOT} / ${WORKSPACE_DIR} tokens, the same convention metadata/schemas/build-plan-v1.schema.json's planPathMode: tokened uses -- a consumer substitutes its own resolved paths before use. scripts/check_bootstrap_manifest.py is the drift gate: it fails if this file disagrees with west.yml's zephyr revision, if either bootstrap script still hardcodes a Zephyr version literal instead of deriving it from here, or if the CI workflows' own Zephyr pins disagree with zephyr.version.

linux.command: sudo apt-get install -y libmosquitto-dev libasound2-dev libssl-dev pkg-config

note: macOS uses CoreAudio rather than ALSA, so the Yocto audio backend doesn't apply on macOS hosts.
Under Git Bash / MSYS2 the Yocto-side backends aren't intended to run -- the canonical use is WSL2 + Ubuntu with the linux command above; skip this step on native Windows.

The Arm GNU Toolchain and the Zephyr SDK (`west sdk install`) are separate manual, one-time installs on native Windows -- not auto-installed by bootstrap.ps1; native_sim / Yocto need WSL2 (docs/cross-platform-setup.md section 5).
